name: Western US MTBS-Interagency (WUMI) wildfire dataset
model_or_instrument: Monitoring Trends in Burn Severity (MTBS) program and federal agencies (CalFire, FWS, FS, BIA, BLM, BOR, NPS)

scales.note: WUMI wildfire dataset over Western US (west of 103W) mapped to 12 km grid; 1984 to 2020 (37 years)
